fullPassage: Art Nouveau, literally meaning “new art,” is a style of art that emerged as a means to depart from Historicism, which relied heavily on copying or reinterpreting works from past artistic movements. In an effort to revive craftsmanship and establish a genuinely modern aesthetic that would reflect the changing times, Art Nouveau artists and designers placed emphasis on innovation, experimentation, and originality in their creations. They drew much of their inspiration from natural objects: flowers, plants, insects, and other organic forms. This focus on nature was reflected in the asymmetrical lines, curvilinear shapes, and intricate patterns that all became the hallmarks of the Art Nouveau style. Aspiring to “total works of the arts,” the practitioners of Art Nouveau used these elements to create a sense of harmony in their work. This is apparent in the works of Antoni Gaudí such as Park Güell, the design of which is perfectly integrated into the landscape, with columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings.

questions.passage: Art Nouveau, literally meaning “new art,” is a style of art that emerged as a means to depart from Historicism, which relied heavily on copying or reinterpreting works from past artistic movements. In an effort to revive craftsmanship and establish a genuinely modern aesthetic that would reflect the changing times, Art Nouveau artists and designers placed emphasis on innovation, experimentation, and originality in their creations. They drew much of their inspiration from natural objects: flowers, plants, insects, and other organic forms. This focus on nature was reflected in the asymmetrical lines, curvilinear shapes, and intricate patterns that all became the hallmarks of the Art Nouveau style. Aspiring to “total works of the arts,” the practitioners of Art Nouveau used these elements to create a sense of harmony in their work. This is apparent in the works of Antoni Gaudí such as Park Güell, the design of which is perfectly integrated into the landscape, with columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 제목은 과거에서 벗어나 자연의 형태로 표현한 아르누보를 담아야 해요.

① 'Historicism's Triumph over Modern Design(현대 디자인에 대한 역사주의의 승리)' — 아르누보가 역사주의에서 벗어난 글이라 반대예요

② 'The Decline of Craftsmanship in the Modern Age(현대의 장인 정신 쇠퇴)' — 오히려 장인 정신을 '되살리려' 했어요

③ 'Symmetry and Straight Lines in Classical Art(고전 예술의 대칭과 직선)' — 아르누보는 비대칭·곡선이 특징이라 반대예요

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄은 기둥이 자연에서 저절로 돋아난 듯 보인다는 뜻으로, 건축이 자연과 하나처럼 어우러짐을 비유해요.

① The building looks as if it naturally grew out of its environment.(건물이 마치 자연에서 저절로 자라난 것처럼 보인다) — 자연 경관에 완벽히 통합(perfectly integrated)된 설계를 비유한 것이라 알맞아요 ←정답

② The columns were carved from the trunks of living trees.(기둥을 살아 있는 나무 줄기로 깎았다) — 실제로 나무로 만들었다는 뜻이 아니라 비유예요

③ The garden was cleared away to make room for the columns.(기둥을 세우려 정원을 없앴다) — 자연을 없앴다는 것은 통합과 반대예요

④ The design pays no attention to the surrounding scenery.(설계가 주변 경관을 전혀 신경 쓰지 않는다) — 자연과 어우러진다는 내용과 반대예요
det.tip: sprouting from natural surroundings = 자연에서 돋아난 듯 = 자연과 하나처럼 어우러짐(비유).
